svg.title: Жим гири двумя руками — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. STANDING TWO-HANDED PRESS OF ONE KETTLEBELL. Both hands hold the SAME single kettlebell by its loop handle/horns, centered in front of body. Left: kettlebell held at upper chest, elbows bent down near torso. Right: both arms press that same ONE kettlebell overhead together. No separate kettlebells, no barbell, no dumbbells. Front three-quarter view, stable standing feet, no bench. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
